messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Prospect (RegulaPay) POC hitting intermittent 502/504 and stream stalls from our TS client when routed through their corporate proxy. Theyre worried it's an SDK bug. Can we swarm?
devon_se: Most likely proxy/TCP idle termination or proxy auth (NTLM) rehandshake. Do we have a minimal log or curl repro?
leo_devex: They shared this Node log: 
```
Error: socket hang up
status: 502
proxy: proxy.regula.internal:8080
```
Also saw EAI_AGAIN occasionally.
anya_support: On gateway traces I see repeated connection reuse, then FIN from remote after ~40-70s. A small spike of 429s during reconnect storms.
maria_sales: They asked if switching to Dedicated or using a bastion will fix it and whether that changes compliance docs and POC costs.
devon_se: Short plan: 1) customer tries client-side mitigations (keepalive, force http1.1, timeout + backoff), 2) if still flaky, use an outbound bastion/NAT for POC. That usually adds a small infra cost (~$100-250/mo).
leo_devex: Pasteable quick fixes for them:
- Use an http(s).Agent with keepAlive=true and keepAliveMsecs ~20000-30000
- Force HTTP/1.1 for streaming as a probe to rule out h2/proxy issues
- Connect timeout 5s, read/stream timeout 60-90s; retry 429 with jitter (max 3)
- For Python: requests.Session + HTTPAdapter(pool) + limited retries
- Try forcing IPv4 or add a hosts entry if EAI_AGAIN appears
- Run `curl --http1.1 -N -v` behind proxy and capture tcpdump for us
maria_sales: And about compliance?
legal-bot: Note: adding a customer-managed bastion/NAT does not by itself change SOC2/ISO deliverables. Private/VPC deployments trigger enterprise compliance and SOW.
anya_support: I added a short checklist and linked the bastion estimator in the POC doc. If they share tcpdump + client logs we can deep-dive live.
maria_sales: Thanks all  I scheduled a 30m debug call tomorrow 10am PT. Please join if available.
